Specification: This module is an internal support module for Apalache rewritings and does not model a distributed algorithm or transition system. It defines dummy placeholder operators for folding over sets, folding over sequences, and constructing sequences, with comments stating that Apalache rewires these operators to efficient internal implementations. The module contains only pure operator definitions, no state variables, no actions, and no temporal or verification properties.
